description: One fork-bot Renovate run waiting for approval on tap-plugin-github-core, with everything the decision fetches. Field shapes follow GitHub's REST responses (runs list, repositories/{id}, pulls, pulls/{n}/files). Ids and shas are made up; the files, with their patches, are the real ones of tap-plugin-github-core#190. Tests mutate a copy.

pulls.description: GET repos/{target}/pulls/{n} for each open PR from tap-renovate-remote:{run.head_branch}

org_repos.description: GET repos/unified-systems-com/{repo} for each of our repositories the PR pins a sha in.

compares.description: `status` of GET repos/{repo}/compare/{sha}...{default_branch}, keyed '{repo} {sha}...{branch}'. The tap sha is the one tap-plugin-github-core#190 pins; the live compare said `ahead` on 2026-09-27.
